text:
maria: Quick sync — packaging team ready to hand the private installer to the carrier tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final signoff on sub-manifest and escort window.

dave: ✅ artifacts built, delta bundle + full installer. Attached checksums in the manifest. I pushed the signer metadata to ci-artifacts.

sean: Carrier ETA good. We need: cosign sigs, KMS envelope ID, and an on-call escort contact. Also confirm whether we include the delta patch for customers on 1.2.x.

maria: include delta for 1.2.x, yes. Escort is @sean on call for the transfer window 09:00–11:00 UTC. Carrier will validate checksums and cosign again on receipt.

anika: security check: rotation window for the cosign key is noon UTC. We mustn't rotate until transfer completes. Also require audit log export to kinesis for the transfer.

oliver: pm note — update release notes to mark that this release requires offline manifest apply v2 and document the sub-manifest breakage risk.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: env=private-canary-1, group=3 hosts, start=09:30 UTC, canary-window=15m.

dave: upload manifests: 
```
$ sha256sum redwood-installer-2.0.tar.gz
3b5c9f2...  redwood-installer-2.0.tar.gz
$ sha256sum redwood-delta-1.2->2.0.patch
a7d1e4c...  redwood-delta-1.2->2.0.patch
```

sean: carrier will verify with cosign: 
```
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/release-keys/airgap redwood-installer-2.0.tar.gz
```
I'll be on the call to confirm the cosign output.

maria: contingency: if carrier fails verification on receipt, abort transfer and instruct carrier to return media. dave, pre-stage signed tar to s3-ephemeral in case we need re-sign.

dave: done. Pre-staged to s3://ephemeral-release/2320000000/ and updated sub-manifest.hint -> signed: true

anika: policy reminder: if cosign verification reports unknown signer or tampered file, escalate to security Slack channel and hold shipment.

deploy-bot: canary update: private-canary-1 host2 failed health check at +8m, errors ~502 proxy timeout.

maria: noted. What’s the impact? threshold for abort is 2 hosts failing or >5% error rate.

sean: logs show the host hit an unexpected L7 timeout against customer network. Could be carrier-side transient. Will re-run health probe and hold canary until 09:45.

dave: while we hold, can we validate local checksum and cosign again? Re-uploaded signature to pre-stage with timestamp.

maria: yes, please re-verify. If second host fails or errors persist, we roll back canary and pause the handoff.

deploy-bot: canary paused by maria at 09:38 UTC. Reason: intermittent host errors.

anika: security note — do not rotate cosign key. Also capture container image layer digests, not just top-level artifact checksum.

dave: pulled layer list and wrote digests to sub-manifest.layers. Here's snippet:
```
- sha256:4f3a...
- sha256:c1d2...
```

sean: carrier still online on call. They re-verified files, cosign verify OK, but their transport checksum didn't match our pre-stage: carrier got `3b5c9f2...` vs ours `3b5c9f2...` (same) — false alarm, formatting strip on their end. They re-transferred via SCP, verified OK.

maria: good. Given the transient canary failure, plan: resume canary at 09:50 UTC for 10m, if any host fails again or overall error rate >3% we abort and do a full rollback. If stable, we proceed with handoff complete at 10:15 UTC and signer rotation at 12:00 UTC.

oliver: will update release notes and email customers in private-delivery channel about the slightly delayed handoff window.

deploy-bot: canary resumed at 09:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: canary completed at 09:59 UTC — 0 hosts failing, error rate 0.8%.

maria: proceeding with handoff. Sean, confirm carrier will ship only after you give the final OK — we need human gate.

sean: final OK given at 10:05 UTC. Carrier instructed to proceed with secure transit and to re-run `cosign verify` on arrival.

dave: final artifact pinning: sub-manifest.signed=true, image-tags pinned to: [redwood/engine:2.0-pinned, redwood/runtime:3.1-pinned]

anika: logged the decision in security incident ledger id S-2320 and captured the audit export.

maria: thanks team. Postmortem note: add a short blurb about carrier formatting causing false checksum mismatch and we should standardize newline handling in their scp scripts.

oliver: noted. I'll add to release retro and ensure docs for carrier ingest mention canonical checksum format.

deploy-bot: release artifact registry updated, release state: delivered-offsite, signer-rotation-scheduled=2023-12-01T12:00:00Z.
